_comment: The negative control for the conversation harness. Every entry here is WRONG
A conversation harness that passes its own cases proves nothing: a scorer that
always returns pass would produce the same table. What this file pins is that
each of the four ways a merge can go wrong is actually detected — criteria not
carried, criteria carried that should not be, disclosure missing, and
disclosure claimed for something the turn restated.
The pricing axis is not falsifiable from a case file: it compares a fresh turn
against the same request run standalone, and both go through the same code. It
is checked structurally instead (a 'quoted' outcome must carry a total). Saying
so here is better than listing it as covered.

conversations.name: NEGATIVE: the quantity is not carried
conversations.proves: detects a merge that drops a refinement

conversations.name: NEGATIVE: a new subject wrongly inherits
conversations.proves: detects carried constraints surviving a subject change

turns.request: letter-size flyers, one side, colour, under 250 a pack, 20 packs

conversations.name: NEGATIVE: the disclosure is missing
conversations.proves: detects a reply that remembers something and does not say so

reply_contains: Remembered from your earlier message: nothing at all

conversations.name: NEGATIVE: a restated field is called remembered
conversations.proves: detects a reply claiming to remember what the turn just said
